title: Build a Microservice with Go #2 - Routes & Handlers
comment_samples: This complete session went over my head
the first video of the series was very informative. this video seems like assumes the viewers already know everything.

I wish I'd had this series to learn from when I was learning Go.

Rob Pike said something like 'simplicity is complicated' and I took it at the time to mean keeping a solution simple and clean can be hard to do but worth the effort. With a minimum amount of boilerplate code,  straight forward, thought out and clear design and pragmatic use of tooling this series gives us a blueprint to start creating APIs in Go that is easy to follow, adopt and modify.

Thanks for the hard work that has gone into this. Its made to look easy but there's a lot in it !
I started learning htmx and now I connect this with golang <3
